title: Te Reo Kāore i Whakarongohia o Ngā Rau Tau
intro: I mua noa atu i te aranga ake o ngā tāone nui, ka ara ake tētahi wairua mokemoke i roto i tētahi iwi kua tahuri ke i te pono. Ko tō rātou uauatanga anake i rite ki te manawanui o tēnei kaikaranga mokemoke, i inoi i roto i ngā whakatipuranga me te kore e ngaro te whakaaro. I te wa i taka ai ngā whakatūpato katoa ki ngā taringa turi, ka hurihia te ao e tētahi whakatau tata. I tēnei rā, kei te rere tonu ngā haruru o taua kōrero i roto i ia whakahuatanga. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei wairua pakari?
clues: I whakatipuria ahau i roto i te iwi i karakia ki ngā whakapakoko teka, ā, i wareware ki ngā tohu e karapoti ana i a rātou, heoi i whiriwhiria ahau hei whakaara i a rātou i tō rātou mangere.
I karanga atu ahau ki taku iwi i ngā wā katoa, engari i whakapae mai rātou he tangata noa iho ahau pērā i a rātou, e tawai ana i taku karere, e puru ana i ō rātou taringa.
I te pō, i te ao, i inoi ahau ki a rātou me te whakaaro nui, me ngā whakamahara ngawari, engari ko aku kupu te āhua nei kua memeha haere ki te rangi, kāore i rangona, kāore hoki i arohia.
I raro i te tohutohu a te Atua, i hanga e ahau tētahi waka nui i hangaia ki te rakau me ngā papa ki te whenua maroke, ā ka kata mai tōku iwi ki ahau me te mea kua ngaro te whakaaro.
I te taenga mai o te waipuke nui e ai ki te kupu whakaari, kāore taku tama i pai ki te eke tahi māua ki te kaipuke, i te whakapono ka tiakina ia e te maunga i te pikinga ake o te wai.
I riro ahau hei tumuaki mō tētahi tīmatanga hou ki te whenua, ā, kei roto i tētahi upoko o te Quran tōku ingoa e mau nei.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
